title: fritillaria pyrenaica subsp. hispanica
intro: Fritillaria pyrenaica subsp. hispanica, commonly known as the Pyrenean fritillary, is a subspecies of the flowering plant Fritillaria pyrenaica. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria pyrenaica subsp. hispanica include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antitussive properties, which help to relieve congestion, reduce inflammation, and suppress coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
